packages.name: apn-autoconfig
packages.description: POSIX-shell cellular profile detection and testing engine for OpenWrt. It supports already configured ModemManager, QMI and MBIM netifd targets. QMI uses an installed uqmi command with a same-USB-device identity fallback through sms-tool, and MBIM uses an installed umbim; the core does not install a modem manager. It matches SIM identity against a worldwide local TSV database, verifies real Internet access, caches successful profiles per ICCID and safely rolls back failures.

packages.name: apn-autoconfig-integration-huasifei-wh3000
packages.description: Optional board integration for the tested Huasifei WH3000 Pro setup. It maps the BTN_0 release event to the guarded GPIO modem power-cycle and APN reconciliation action. It is not a generic router-button implementation.

packages.name: apn-autoconfig-modem
packages.description: POSIX-shell modem-control foundation for apn-autoconfig. Provides read-only modem inventory with stable hardware identity independent of volatile device names, explicit ModemManager/direct-control ownership state and a serialized per-modem operation coordinator. It does not implement APN policy, network provisioning, MBIM profile mutation or eSIM lifecycle; see docs/modem-contract-v1.md. Optional runtime backends (uqmi, sms-tool, mmcli) are detected, not required, so capability stays truthful.

packages.name: apn-autoconfig-proto-atdial
packages.description: netifd protocol `apn_atdial` for modems that expose no cdc-wdm control channel, such as a Fibocom FM350-GL in RNDIS composition. Their data path is an ordinary usbnet interface, so the host defines and activates the PDP context over an AT port and configures the address the modem reports; the modem serves no DHCP. Port resolution, identity and control-owner arbitration stay in apn-autoconfig-modem, and netifd remains the bearer owner. The Intel XMM path used by Fibocom L850/L860 is implemented but has not been validated on hardware; see docs/atdial-contract-v1.md.

packages.name: apn-autoconfig-providers
packages.description: Generated worldwide mobile provider and APN profiles for apn-autoconfig. The database can be upgraded independently from the program and LuCI.

packages.name: luci-app-apn-autoconfig
packages.description: Status, safe background actions and configuration for apn-autoconfig.
